//: The one place the web app is configured. Docker rewrites ApiBaseUrl and Platform at container start (see docker/20-api-base-url.sh and deploy/render/entrypoint.sh); the mobile app's equivalent is App.Mobile/Resources/Raw/appsettings.json.
//Platform: Mobile ON THIS BRANCH (development_mobileview), Web on development. This branch exists to render the phone shell, so a plain `dotnet run` or RunFrontend.cmd on :7001 serves the mobile app's UI, and phoneFrame.js wraps it in a 412x915 handset whenever the browser window is desktop-sized (a phone-sized window, or ?frame=0, gets it full-bleed). Mobile also switches non-Admin users to the Mobile column of the access matrix, which is why development keeps Web and why this branch is never merged back into it. Deployed containers overwrite this file at start and take Platform from the PLATFORM environment variable instead; render.yaml on this branch sets that to Mobile too.
//MobilePreviewOrigins: Origins that render the phone shell regardless of Platform, so one build can serve the web shell and the phone shell at the same time from two ports. `dotnet run --project FrontEnd/App.Web --launch-profile mobile` serves :7002; on development :7001 stays the web shell (on this branch both are the phone shell). Local development only - a deployed origin must never appear here, because Mobile also switches every non-Admin user to the Mobile column of the access matrix.
